The '''''Arbiter''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that served as part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Zeck Tambell]] served aboard the ''Arbiter'' for two years as a naval [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]].<ref name="Ringers" />
